repairs.before: Strongest feature: Law provisionally grants that fine-tuning could indicate intelligence, then exposes two distinct identification gaps by offering previous-universe engineers as a designer alternative and asking why any divine designer would be morally good, precisely limiting what the premises could establish. Principal limitation: he does not evaluate whether the proposed engineer alternative is independently plausible, whether it merely relocates fine-tuning, or whether Ward’s broader cumulative case could supply the moral characterization omitted by this single argument. Live burden: Law must compare candidate explanations rather than list possibilities and address whether intelligibility, experience, and moral pressure jointly narrow the designer hypothesis. Locked score: 84 reflects strong coherence, relevance, clarity, calibration, and burden-focused responsiveness, with slightly lower evidential warrant because underdetermination is demonstrated conceptually but the comparative explanatory landscape remains only illustratively developed.
